name: Filter Tasks by Status
description: The user narrows the visible task list by selecting a status from the filter control. Only tasks matching the selected status are shown. Selecting 'All' clears the filter and restores the full list.
preconditions: The Task List screen is visible

main_flow.description: Selects a status from the filter control
Shows only tasks matching the selected status

alternative_flows.name: No tasks match
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 2, no tasks match the selected status
steps: System displays a 'no results' message (not an error)

postconditions: The task list shows only tasks matching the selected filter, or all tasks if no filter is active
business_rules: Filter options are Todo, In Progress, Done, plus an 'All' option to clear the filter
Filtering is applied immediately — no submit action required
When no tasks match the filter, a 'no results' message is shown (not an error state)

bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen and tasks with different statuses exist
bdd_scenarios.when: The user selects a status from the filter control
bdd_scenarios.then: Only tasks matching the selected status are displayed

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Filter Tasks by Status — no results
bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen with a filter active
bdd_scenarios.when: No tasks match the selected status
bdd_scenarios.then: A 'no results' message is shown and no task cards are displayed

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Filter Tasks by Status — filter cleared
bdd_scenarios.given: The user has a status filter active
bdd_scenarios.when: The user selects 'All' to clear the filter
